about: The names of the agent socket between OldIPMI and oldipmi-mcp, by the rest of their constant name: desktop/agentops.h has agentops::Op*, internal/mcp/agentops.go has op*. A request names one of ops in op; exchanges.json records each of them as the app answers it. api is the version of the agent API (agentops::Api, agentAPI) that the reply to hello reports beside the ops the app offers; new ops and keys leave it as it is. codes are the kinds of error that an error reply names in code beside its message (agentops::Err*); oldipmi-mcp passes on the message.
